snippet.title: Double Trip - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Help us by wishlisting the game on Steam!
- Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3414480/Double_Trip
- Itch.io page: https://maxyland.itch.io/double-trip

-- ABOUT THE GAME --
Double Trip is a tile-based sokoban game about solving puzzles with the help of two friendly characters. Travel through a beautiful island by learning how its different elements interact with each other.

Cover and promotional art made by @DavJT.

A game made by @MaxyLAND and Javago.
